quarterly_data.signal: Palo Alto Networks launched Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense, an agentic continuous offensive-security service available worldwide on an annual subscription (options vary by the OpenAI, Anthropic and open-source models used), running a proprietary multi-model harness built around gated models including Anthropic Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI GPT-5.6-Cyber. The company developed it over six months of in-house testing and more than 100 Unit 42 customer engagements with a $17 million R&D and methodology investment; internally it found a year's worth of exposures in three weeks, and its Frontier AI Exposure Analysis found exposures in 100% of customers assessed, 37% of them high or critical.
